test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the compound interest on a sum of ₹25,000 after three years at a rate of 12 percent per annum interest compounded yearly?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹25,000

Rate (R) = 12% per annum

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest (CI): CI = P(1 + R/100)T - P

**Solution:**

⇒ CI = 25000(1 + 12/100)³ - 25000

⇒ 25000(1.12)³ - 25000

⇒ 25000 × 1.404928 - 25000

⇒ 35123.2 - 25000 = ₹10,123.20

**The compound interest is ₹10,123.20.**
